changelog:
- Initial release of the prospect-enrich skill for LinkedIn data enrichment via Veezee.
- Supports enrichment of prospect lists using LinkedIn URLs, slugs, or names.
- Returns current title, company, and work history data for each prospect.
- Includes guidance for free API key setup and usage caps.
- Summarizes credit usage per batch for easy budgeting.
summary: Enrich a list of prospects (profile URLs, slugs, or names) with LinkedIn role and experience data via Veezee. Use when the user wants current titles, companies, or work history for known people, or asks to "enrich" leads/prospects/candidates.
